# Andorra public sources

Educational catalog; live endpoints, reuse notes, known traps and example calls.

| ID | Source | Sector | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|
| `afa-feeds` | Andorran Financial Authority feeds | finance | Main and category RSS or Atom feeds for alerts, press releases, new regulation and financial education. |
| `bopa` | Butlletí Oficial del Principat d'Andorra | legislation | Full-text search over official bulletins and live HTML or PDF access to published documents from 1989 onward. |
| `carburants` | Fuel stations and reference prices | energy | ArcGIS layers for 75 fuel stations and 275 current reference-price records. |
| `cass-estadistiques` | CASS statistics downloads | social-security | Periodic PDF and spreadsheet downloads including pension calendars and registration movements. |
| `consell-general-feeds` | Consell General news feeds | parliament | RSS and Atom feeds for live parliamentary news and legislative tracking. |
| `e-tramits` | e-tramits procedures | public-services | Searchable HTML catalog of 645 administrative procedures in Catalan, Spanish and French. |
| `estadistica-api` | Andorra Department of Statistics API | statistics | Public API for 2,709 statistical tables with search, topic groups, JSON-stat data, CSV, XLSX and SDMX exports. |
| `govern-ad` | Govern d'Andorra information pages | public-services | Liferay information pages from Govern d'Andorra, indexed by section headings and fetched live for cited content. |
| `meteo-ad` | meteo.ad station charts | meteorology | HTML station chart pages embed recent Highcharts categories and series. |
| `sig-arcgis` | Govern d'Andorra ArcGIS Enterprise | geography | ArcGIS REST catalog with curated fuel, traffic, weather, street, population, tourism, bus and parish layers. |
| `transparencia` | Transparency portal | transparency | HTML portal linking to procurement, plans, grants, budgets, public entities, inventories and agreements. |
